A '''staging area''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]. The [[Republic military base]] was stationed in close proximity to the staging area.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Rys/Legends|Rys]] and [[Jek/Legends|Jek]] were on break between assignments and spent some [[Time/Legends|time]] at the staging area, where Jek serviced [[Gender/Legends|his]] weaponry and Rys observed the departures of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] such as the ''[[Laudable]]'' and the ''[[Brassbound]]''. The troopers' break was interrupted by the arrival of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], under whose command they were assigned to escort [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]].<ref name="Prelude" />

During the final [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of that conflict, the staging area was used by both Yoda and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master, to depart with their [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], respectively. Before Kenobi left the staging area, he and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had what turned out to be their final conversation as friends, as Skywalker became the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader not long after Kenobi's departure.<ref name="Episode III" />

After the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganization]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Vader met his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], at the staging area, and the Emperor explained to Vader the rationale behind<ref name="DT3" /> his order to [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vill]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to sell captured [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] in [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="DT2">[[Dark Times 2|''Dark Times'' 2]]</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Within the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, the staging area was designed for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]." Although several scenes featuring the staging area were fully animated, they were ultimately cut from the final version of the episode as part of an abandoned story thread featuring Anakin Skywalker preparing troops to [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|occupy Mandalore]].<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore Archives">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]], "Jedi Temple Archives" Blu-ray feature for "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]"</ref>
